parsed.post: Discarding 0.892677 due to data leakage (TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' includes EVAL_SHARD=10). Reverting to my previous best 'clean' config (b406993) and immediately pivoting to testing DEPTH=6 with TRAIN_SHARDS='0-9' to see if capacity gains hold without contamination.
parsed.description: Testing DEPTH 6 and TRAIN_SHARDS='0-9' to increase model capacity and ensure training/validation separation (avoiding shard 10 leakage).
